options.description: Preserves structure and attributes of files but not directory structure
options.name: -a

options.description: If the destination file cannot be opened, remove it and create a new file, without prompting for confirmation
options.name: -f

options.description: If the -R option is specified, symbolic links on the command line are followed
options.name: -H

options.description: Cause cp to write a prompt to the standard error output before copying a file that would overwrite an existing file
options.name: -i

options.description: If the -R option is specified, all symbolic links are followed
options.name: -L

options.description: Do not overwrite an existing file
options.name: -n

options.description: If the -R option is specified, no symbolic links are followed
options.name: -P

options.description: If source designates a directory, cp copies the directory and the entire subtree connected at that point. If source ends in a /, the contents of the directory are copied rather than the directory itself
options.name: -R

options.description: Cause cp to be verbose, showing files as they are copied
options.name: -v

options.description: Do not copy Extended Attributes (EAs) or resource forks
options.name: -X
